source_semantics.idempotency: EnqueueExternal requires a nonblank idempotency key and, for the same owner, reuses the newest existing External job whose trimmed key matches using ordinal case-insensitive semantics.
source_semantics.registration_only: When no idempotent match exists, EnqueueExternal delegates to the same registration core as tracked enqueue but marks the job External; it does not manufacture execution progress or completion.
source_semantics.initial_state: A new External job is Waiting with zero progress and zero processed items, totalItems clamped to at least one, null start/completion/error state, normalized correlation metadata and one initial registration activity.
source_semantics.duplicate_state: An idempotent duplicate returns the existing job and does not append a duplicate job or activity.

laravel_adaptation.ledger_mapping: The canonical external registration is adapted onto the existing tenant-owned operation_executions and operation_logs control plane; no competing execution ledger or provider runtime is introduced.
laravel_adaptation.tenant_owner_site_scope: Laravel strengthens the source boundary by requiring an active TenantContext, the exact active membership owner, server-side operations.manage authorization, and a site that belongs to the active tenant.
laravel_adaptation.idempotency_mapping: The raw external key is normalized before matching, but persistence stores only a case-normalized SHA-256 dedupe fingerprint plus a credential-redacted display form. The tenant row is locked inside the registration transaction on MySQL so same-tenant duplicate decisions serialize; External mode and owner scope are part of the match so Tracked work and other owners cannot collide.
laravel_adaptation.state_mapping: Canonical Waiting maps to queued with progress=0, processed_items=0, total_items>=1 and null result/failure/start/completion fields. A duplicate returns the originally registered row and values.
laravel_adaptation.activity_mapping: Exactly one info registration log is created atomically with a new job and carries the canonical ExecutionCenterService.EnqueueExternal marker; duplicate calls create no extra activity.
laravel_adaptation.redaction: Credential-like assignments in title, site name and idempotency display are redacted before return or persistence; only the one-way idempotency fingerprint is retained for matching.

acceptance.isolation_assertion_mode: Focused service acceptance proves foreign-tenant site and wrong-owner registration rejection plus database exclusion; authorization failure is explicit and tenant-owned external rows remain scoped to their owner.
acceptance.external_runtime: No live WordPress/provider/email/payment/DNS/manual evidence is required because EnqueueExternal only registers tenant-local external-work metadata and never claims that an external provider executed or completed the job.
